name: Bathala
description: The supreme deity of the Tagalogs, creator of the world, as Plasencia recorded.
sources: Juan de Plasencia, Customs of the Tagalogs (1589), in Blair and Robertson, The Philippine Islands 1493–1898, vol. 7
F. Landa Jocano, Philippine Mythology (Community Publishers, 1969)

lore.en: Plasencia wrote in 1589 that the Tagalogs honored Bathala above all others as the maker of all things. Bathala was not approached for everyday favors: those went to the anito. In the stories Bathala is distant and great. This game names Bathala only in story, never as a power to buy or call.
lore.fil: Isinulat ni Plasencia noong 1589 na iginagalang ng mga Tagalog si Bathala higit sa lahat bilang lumikha ng lahat ng bagay. Hindi kay Bathala hinihingi ang pang-araw-araw na pabor: sa anito iyon. Sa mga kuwento, malayo at dakila si Bathala. Sa larong ito, sa kuwento lamang binabanggit si Bathala, hindi kailanman bilang kapangyarihang mabibili o matatawag.

inGame.en: Only in story: Bathala is never a blessing or a reward.
inGame.fil: Sa kuwento lamang: hindi kailanman basbas o gantimpala si Bathala.

hint.en: Choose the Tagalog tradition at the Dambana.
hint.fil: Piliin ang tradisyong Tagalog sa Dambana.
